# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall young man with wavy chestnut hair, broad shoulders, and bright, direct light-brown eyes. As a boy in school, he possessed a mouth contorted into a mocking grin. Nell considers him an exceptionally good-looking youth with an open face, though he lacks the secretive or gloomy features of her imagined dream man.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh is high-spirited, mischievous, and brave enough to own up to his mistakes, such as taking the blame when he provokes his classmates. He is open, direct, and popular among his peers. Possessing strong moral principles and serious ambitions, he guards his speech and actions to remain worthy of good companionship. He is determined to work hard and contribute meaningfully to society.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c7 P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## Goals

- to become a doctor and combat illness, suffering, and ignorance  <sub>[v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)</sub>
- to contribute genuine labor and advance human understanding  <sub>[v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)</sub>
- to remain worthy of Nell's friendship and potential affection  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)</sub>

## History

When Hugh was around ten years old, his father fell ill, prompting a three-year relocation to Alberta during which Hugh barely attended school. Upon returning to Brierley at nearly fourteen, he joined the fourth book class at Brierley School, where he was accustomed to leading his grade. During class, he engaged in pranks, such as pinning Opal Pettigrew's plait to her chair and pulling Nell Harcourt's crimson hair while teasing her. This provoked Nell to hit him over the head with her slate, breaking it. Hugh took full responsibility to the teacher, Mr. Pidgeon, and apologized to Nell afterward, though she initially refused to forgive him. He later joined the Regent's class alongside his peers. As he matured, Hugh decided to pursue a medical career to help fight disease and ignorance. He also became involved with the local Improvement Society.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)_

## Quotes

> Carrots! Carrots!  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

> Mr. Pidgeon, the blame belongs to me because I provoked her.  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042)</sub>

> Nell, I’m terribly apologetic about mocking your hair. Truly I am. Please don’t stay angry forever.  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

> It is a wonderful career. Throughout existence, a person must battle against something . . . was it not once stated that man is a combative creature? . . . and my desire is to battle illness and suffering and lack of knowledge . . . which are entirely interconnected. Nell, I desire to contribute my portion of genuine, sincere labor to this earth . . . contribute a tiny bit to the total of human understanding that every noble person has collected since the start of time. Those who existed prior to my time have accomplished a great deal for my benefit, so I desire to demonstrate my appreciation by accomplishing something for those who will exist following my time. In my view, that represents the sole method a person can settle his debts to humanity.  <sub>[v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)</sub>

> I believe you achieve that goal daily,  <sub>[v2 c7 P16](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0016)</sub>
